title: CountAggregated
description: Objects of a class counted in a grid cell over a period. The analytical view of vision. Carries no track_ref: an hour-scoped per-person handle in a 90-day store reconstructs exactly what the hour scoping prevents. Coarse geo only, and buckets below the floor are suppressed rather than published.

object_class.description: Assigned object class. Consumers MUST ignore unknown values.

count.description: Objects counted. Floored at 5; smaller buckets are suppressed, because a count of one in a cell and an hour describes a person.

period_start.description: Start of the aggregation period, inclusive.

period_end.description: End of the aggregation period, exclusive.

asset_ref.description: Camera the counts were derived from.

provenance.description: How the fact was produced. Required on every event.
